title: Addon Source Catalog And Marketplace
problem: Nako now has a manager-owned lifecycle plan slot, but it still lacks a discoverable addon source catalog and marketplace boundary for listing, resolving, and browsing installable addon sources.

evidence.summary: Lane opened after the Addon Manager lifecycle lane closed with a proven manager-owned registry/plan slot.
Reference study completed against Jellyfin plugin repositories, Home Assistant app repositories, Visual Studio Code extension manifests, and Obsidian plugin manifests/version gating.

continue_policy.notes: Continue while the current target remains the addon source catalog / marketplace discovery boundary. Split package signing, provider breadth, and direct process/container supervision into follow-ons.
